data.name: Speed Goes Up
data.detailed_description:
Make every lap faster—and more valuable.

Speed Goes Up is a single player incremental arcade racer about making the number climb. Run time trials, earn Bits every time you complete a lap, then reinvest your winnings in speed, handling, drift, boost, and a stronger racing economy.

Every Lap Matters

Chase personal bests in continuous time trials while your latest and fastest laps stay on the clock. Timed lap challenges reward precise driving, while long term lap mastery turns persistence into lasting payout bonuses.

Put Your Best Lap to Work

Record a fast route, purchase a Ghost, and watch it replay your personal best. Ghosts earn a share of the lap reward each time they finish, turning your own driving into a growing income engine across unlocked tracks.

Build a Faster Machine

Spend Bits in a branching Garage upgrade tree. Raise top speed, acceleration, braking, handling, and lap payouts. Unlock drifting, build Heat through controlled slides, then spend that Heat on boost to break past your normal speed ceiling.

Each track also has its own Pit Upgrades. Improve its lap reward, add more Ghosts, and invest in specialised bonuses that strengthen the wider run.

Tracks That Push Back

Learn authored floating circuits shaped by hills, railway crossings, low grip ice, alternate routes, moving gates, speed pads, and timed hazards. Smash through obstacles when you are fast enough, choose the right line through branching sections, and take on one-on-one races for permanent progression rewards.

Reset. Rebuild. Go Faster.

Prestige turns a completed build into permanent lap reward power. Begin again with that payout boost and your Legacy Cores intact, work through new upgrade tiers, and unlock a new machine as you chase the next speed ceiling.

Features

  • Single player arcade racing with incremental progression

  • Continuous time trials with latest lap and personal best tracking

  • Income generating Ghosts based on your own fastest recorded routes

  • A branching Garage tree for speed, handling, economy, drift, Heat, and boost

  • Pit Upgrades, timed challenges, and long-term lap mastery

  • Prestige progression with permanent payout growth and new cars

  • Vehicle paint choices and performance tuning

  • Authored tracks with distinct surfaces, routes, shortcuts, and hazards

data.short_description: Race, earn, upgrade, repeat. Turn faster laps into Bits, build a fleet of income generating Ghosts, master drift powered boost, race other cars, and push your vehicle to its limits

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 530, GeForce GT 730, or Radeon R7 240
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD 630, GeForce GTX 750 Ti, or Radeon RX 460
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (2016 or newer) or Apple M1
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris 540 or Apple M1 integrated graphics; hardware-accelerated WebGL 2
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 13 Ventura or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel quad-core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1, Intel Iris Plus 655, or Radeon Pro 555
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
